A Ger Retreat on the Open Steppe

About Us

A Ger Retreat on the Open Steppe

Nestled on Mongolia's open steppe, Talbiun Lodge offers a rare opportunity to experience traditional nomadic hospitality without sacrificing modern comfort. Each ger is handcrafted by local artisans using time-honored techniques.

Discover Our Story

Location

In the Heart of the Steppe

Located in Mongolia's pristine Orkhon Valley, Talbiun Lodge offers an unparalleled connection with nature. Surrounded by rolling grasslands, ancient volcanic peaks, and the winding Orkhon River, this is where tradition meets tranquility.

Orkhon Valley, Mongolia
